changes.summary: Thingamajob’s public experience changed substantially: the historical demo was replaced as the primary interaction by the unfinished Text/URL/File evaluator. It uses James’s canonical career evidence, clearly labels itself as a working prototype, retains detailed assessments privately, preserves the public/protected boundary, and uses the existing controlled same-origin evaluation path.

The theme menu was also optimized without redesigning it. Nine first-open lazy SVG requests were consolidated into one content-hashed, immutably cached SVG sprite while preserving the approved artwork, labels, keyboard/focus behavior, forced-colors behavior and accessibility.
The homepage restored the deployment grid beside the lightweight Buildometer teaser. The teaser matches Thingamajob’s desktop width, with natural stacking when the pair no longer fits.

The deployment grid gained opt-in hidden columns, responsive visual ellipsis, compact semantic UTC timestamps and accessible status-based striping. Home uses the compact treatment while other consumers keep their existing defaults.
